notes: Matched generation (see README): both sides make upstream's single API call per question (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, max_tokens 1000, temperature 0, top_p 1, seed 42); the Harbor side runs the charxiv-direct agent. Judge gpt-4o-2024-08-06 on both sides (upstream's gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is retired), exact-match short-circuit off (CHARXIV_EXACT_MATCH_SHORTCUT=0), descriptive grading one question per judge call on both sides. Parity subset --split parity: 100 of 1000 validation charts (random.Random(42)) x 5 questions = 400 descriptive + 100 reasoning tasks. Runs: 3 independent upstream runs; Harbor n_attempts=3, run k = the k-th attempt of each task by start time. No generation failures or judge failures on either side. Run-score ranges overlap for both metrics. Harbor side: harbor 0.23.0 from PyPI, Docker, separate verifier. Order: a 50-question sanity check on both sides (2026-11-15), then the three runs per side (original: three independent runs in parallel; Harbor: one job with n_attempts=3). A standard CLI agent was also run on the Harbor side only (not parity): codex@0.169.1 + gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, 1 run on the same 500 tasks with default task settings: descriptive 67.50, reasoning 28.00, 0 exceptions (see README).
